text: Eleven helicopters over Kharkiv. One’s still over the city when the next one clears the rooftops. How’s your partner at counting?
Eleven. Good thing he has learned to count things other than pigeons.

Open the skill tree after your first victory here. With Attack, he’ll breathe two fireballs at once. With Defense, he’ll have a shield that can stop one projectile per sortie. You only get to choose your branch once.
I’ll decide when we land. Those people at the bus stop look up every time an engine goes over. I’d like them to be able to hear their bus coming.
